claims.claim: Final evaluation completed and qualified; qualification is not evidence of universal validity or superiority.
The final frozen MTEB plane has 126 rows and 135 task/subset columns, not independent benchmark suites; results revision is 6dabbcc68c28ea5f180ce7df79347b3ca9cc6383.

English text-only main-score extraction preserves bounded noncorrelations and maps correlations by (x+1)/2; task-definition revision 5a83aafe4e7140d0606b96f59448c704f31dbf76, global support 32 and row support 12 are manifest rules.
History/test alias and normalized content separation are checked; family holdout additionally separates heuristic family labels. This does not certify true ancestry or pretraining independence.
A shuffled approximately two-thirds reservoir, cut at least eight, is disjoint from a sealed target set fixed across budgets and methods; only observed cells are retrospectively evaluated.
Rank-four ridge ALS with ridge 0.1, fifty sweeps and Gaussian factor initialization SD 0.1 fits observed entries only; historical means remain fixed.

Ridge conditioning and the all-column integrated-variance acquisition formula describe the evaluated source. The rank-one algebra is a surrogate reduction, not an MAE or calibrated posterior guarantee; selection is independent of revealed values.

Donor-excluded auxiliary predictions yield residuals only for observed donor targets; shared-anchor kernel weights are multiplied by overlap fraction, use a 0.025 scale floor, and vanish at zero overlap.

Weighted median residual correction uses effective count (sum w)^2/max(sum(w^2),1e-12) in prediction and calibration, excludes queried columns, clips to [0,1], and leaves the base unchanged at total weight at most 1e-12 or at zero blend. Effective count measures concentration only when the denominator floor is inactive; an active floor introduces absolute-weight-scale dependence without certifying geometric support.
History-only nested calibration uses two validation folds and two donor folds, at most 16 validation rows, 128 donors, 12 auxiliary sweeps, and pool cap min(512,max(64,floor(196608/N))).
Calibration grid h={0.35,0.75,1.5}, tau={4,16}, alpha={0,0.25,0.5,1} includes exact zero fallback; historical finite-cell pooling differs from fixed-target outer row averaging.
ALS arithmetic cost O(E r^2+(M+N)r^3) per sweep and donor-by-column residual storage are direct algebraic consequences of the inspected dense-solve loops, not measured runtime or novel theory.

Five final references are column mean, query mean, random-query low-rank, variance-query low-rank, and linear ridge; query policies differ and centered missing entries in linear ridge are zero-filled.

Constant history preserves masks and replaces observed values by column means. Column shifting rolls each value/mask pair by an independent nonzero offset, preserving per-column observed multisets; controls match model holdout.
Budgets 1,2,4,8 use nested prefixes; seeds 6841,8089,9011; history/test sizes 94/32 except final family split 93/33; six primary condition/seed averages have equal weight.

All six estimators and both holdouts in Table 1, the complete budget table, and seed table reproduce retained episode arrays; the studied configuration has lower aggregate MAE in each holdout than every reference.
Studied MAE model/family=0.038312665669/0.043303020499 versus linear ridge 0.045116500008/0.045383438423; partitions differ, so no causal effect of family membership is inferred.

Primary budget MAEs 0.045233341978,0.042208509062,0.039639061083,0.036150460213 decrease over k=1,2,4,8. Each holdout seed-mean curve decreases, without per-model monotonicity or sufficient-budget claims.
At eight queries studied model/family errors are 0.034476748972/0.037824171454, versus ridge 0.039273276354/0.039840694780.

Paired component resampling uses 400 draws and RNG 424242; quantiles .005/.995 for each of five baselines precede separate minima of lower and upper bounds. These are not a conventional single-comparator interval.
Reported bound minima [0.0021032442082077377,0.009199712663056218] are reconstructed exactly; all baseline-specific intervals in the supplement come from the same retained paired arrays.

Matched model-holdout intact MAE 0.038312665669 rises to 0.064367113099 under constant history and 0.068569520893 under column shifts; shifted column mean is 0.064367113099 and variance low-rank 0.070913935972. The method loses to column mean under shifts.
Constant-history column means and all centered historical linear references equal the studied sealed-target MAE; controls do not isolate any component.
All-unqueried changing-target diagnostic MAEs A/B/C/D=0.036645358811/0.042420107742/0.065275510462/0.063523296739; not a common-target comparison.
Reset replay query sequences matched and maximum absolute prediction difference was zero; diagnostics do not certify all possible leakage checks.

No matched final residual-off, unconditional-residual, donor-only, support-gating, temporal, cross-leaderboard or missingness-stratified result is available; sequential development does not isolate causal components.
Two development configurations have numeric results; one support-gating evaluation has no retained numeric performance and an unknown failure cause. It is not a measured loss.
Manifest records current CC0-1.0 evidence and Apache-2.0 metadata but absence of a results license at the pinned snapshot; historical licensing remains qualified.
